newsitem.title: FINLAND: FIN MIN NIINISTO DENIES FLAGGING MARKKA - ERM LINK.
newsitem.headline: FIN MIN NIINISTO DENIES FLAGGING MARKKA - ERM LINK.

text.p: Finnish Finance Minister Sauli Niinisto on Friday denied a report which quoted him saying outright that Finland will link the markka to ERM this autumn.
Niinisto was quoted as saying that "the government has signalled that the link will happen in the autumn", but he told Reuters by telephone that he had "certainly not said that".

"The interview was done some three weeks ago ... and that sounds really unfamiliar to me," he said, asked by Reuters to comment on the interview to be published in Monday's newsletter of a big central trade union, the Finnish Confederation of Salaried Employees (STTK).
"Throughout (the interview) it was a question of yes or no, which I made very clear to (the journalist)," Niinisto said.
But he repeated that "it has become increasingly likely that ERM will be a criterion and Finland will make sure that we meet the criteria".
"People can draw their own conclusions from that," he added.

The government has stated that it aims for Finland to meet all entry criteria for the planned third stage of Europe's Economic and Monetary Union (EMU). Parliament will have the final say on whether Finland joins the single currency in the first wave.
